Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Observed controls/mechanics: W accelerates forward; A/D steer left/right. S brakes strongly when moving forward and engages reverse from a stop. While reversing, W first slows reverse motion and engaging forward can require repeated inputs. Gear and six-circle HUD indicators often change without visible movement, so the earlier idea that a gear change consumes the first input remains unproven; the gear display may simply follow recent inputs. S+D was previously seen to swing the nose left while backing, but exact low-speed steering behavior remains uncertain. Space is listed as handbrake. Wet-road steering is highly sensitive: even 0.25–0.5 s steering inputs previously crossed the road or reached grass, while low-speed steering on grass can produce little movement. Hay bales, a red barrier, trees, and the current tree/post area have stopped the car. HUD shows mph, gear, a continuing timer, and six circles that become clear, red/red-X, or blue; their meanings are unconfirmed. Red circles often coincide with throttle and blue with some reverse/handbrake states, but interpreting them as damage, traction, or revs would be speculative.

Course/navigation: The original drive began beneath an arch, followed by a right bend with inside hay bales, narrow wet forest roads with trees/posts and puddles, gentle and tighter bends, another arch, red-and-white barriers, and hay bales. An apparently central hay-bale gap was blocked by a red barrier; reversing and realigning left eventually cleared that area. No finish, explicit objective text, or result screen has appeared. After the latest successful reset, the car followed a wet forest straight and mostly right-hand bends, with one leftward correction. The current trouble spot is a sharper right bend with a close inside tree; repeated low-speed W+D pulses put the front onto inside grass beside that tree.

Successful/failed driving strategies: Sustained full-throttle steering caused corner cutting, grass excursions, and a hay-bale collision. Sustained reverse steering went off the outer edge, and asphalt-recovery throttle repeatedly carried the car across to the opposite edge. On the latest run, short W pulses on straights, S braking to roughly 0–4 mph before bends, and brief W+D pulses generally worked. Coasting/steering at higher speed still caused edge approaches, so alignment was reassessed after every pulse.

Black screens/recovery: Leaving the course or hitting trees repeatedly caused black screens without menu/result text. Enter alone and waiting alone did not recover the first occurrence. Escape sometimes reset immediately or after a wait; Escape + 1 s wait + Enter also worked repeatedly. The latest black-screen recovery used Escape followed by a 1 s wait, resetting the car centered on asphalt at 0 mph; the timer continued in observed cases. Escape behaves differently while visibly stuck, and no reliable visible-stuck reset has been established.

Current stuck episode—observed: The car has remained at 0 mph beside the tree/post, with no confirmed translation despite extensive attempts. Open asphalt is to the left/behind-left and clear ground is directly behind. Straight and steered W/S inputs in every basic direction, repeated one-second holds, and 0.25 s alternating rocking pulses produced only gear/indicator changes or at most slight apparent alignment changes. Steering preload tests (A or D alone, then S or S+D) also failed. Space alone cleared blue indicators once but did not move the car. All straight/steered handbrake-assisted combinations failed. A forward handbrake-launch sequence (W+Space+A, then W+A) failed; a reverse launch (S+Space+D, then S+D) was also attempted. R, R+Enter, Shift+R, Tab, P, H, and B produced no reset/help/menu. Waiting 1 s and 5 s produced no automatic recovery. Escape, Enter, and repeated Escape-wait-Enter sequences failed here. Blind pause-menu guesses (Escape+Down+Enter and Escape+Down+Down+Enter) produced no visible menu/reset. A click at the game center changed the displayed gear from reverse to first, suggesting a possible focus/state change, but subsequent W+A and S+D still failed. Up+Left arrow driving also failed. The timer continues and no terminal result is visible.

Latest state/uncertainty: In the last visible frame before the final input, the car was still pinned at 0 mph against the tree, reverse displayed with three blue indicators after S+Space+D. The final S+D handbrake-release input for 1 s completed, but no subsequent screenshot was supplied, so its effect and exact current position are unknown. Hypotheses about invisible menus, input focus, handbrake latch, collision rocking, and alternate recovery bindings remain unconfirmed and should not be treated as established mechanics.

Active goal: If the final input moved the car, reverse into the clear space without contacting the tree again, regain asphalt to the left/behind-left, then continue slowly with braking before bends and very short steering pulses. If still stuck, further recovery/reset may be needed, but all methods tested so far have failed in this visible-stuck state; do not declare the episode ended without a result screen.
